general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME… IT’S DEBORAH KWAN.
general_information.address: It’s 175 Avenue Road… in Toronto, Ontario.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been this awful low mood thing, and I hardly enjoy anything, and I’m tired all the time. It’s been going on for years now… three years, I think. And even with the antidepressants and that brain stimulation treatment, I still feel stuck. I keep thinking I’d be better off dead, which sounds terrible to say out loud, but that’s there.
current_concerns.goals: I just want something that actually works, honestly. I’m tired of feeling like… like a lost cause.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Hong Kong and moved to Toronto when I was 6. My family had pretty high expectations, and I remember that part more than anything, honestly. I don’t know… I was just a kid, but that’s what stands out to me.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was a strong student, and then I had my first depressive episode when I was 23. That’s kind of where things started changing, I think.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m divorced now — the marriage lasted 12 years. I have one adult daughter, and we’re close.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to find a treatment that lasts, and be present for my daughter.
